positions.commentary: The speaker identifies Microsoft as a technology business with a strong installed base of cloud applications and software that people cannot do without or change easily.
The speaker notes that the index is too dumb to know that it owns AutoZone, implying the stock is undervalued by the index.
The speaker states that the index will never take Tesla out because it is cranking and climbing, unlike companies taken out due to decline.
The speaker asserts that the index is too dumb to know that it owns Alphabet, suggesting the index underappreciates the company.
The speaker mentions that index changes often remove companies like IBM after they have proven to be absolute losers.
The speaker cites Walmart as an example of a company in a difficult retail space that is really great at what it does and can endure for a long time.
The speaker uses Costco as an example of a company in a difficult retail space that is really great at what it does and can endure for a long time.
